headline: Como's Manchester United high meets a rested Sassuolo
summary: Como beat Manchester United 4-1 in the Champions League on Tuesday. Three days later they host Sassuolo, and freshness is the visitors' clearest advantage: Sassuolo have had 8 days since a 2-4 defeat at Frosinone that Italian media called a defensive alarm. Como are fifth with 14 points from seven games but lose A. Diao, who has 4 goals this season. The market still makes Como 61.5% favourites, yet rates them only about a goal better — 1.07, down from 1.28. The main total is 3.25 goals; the chance of more than that is 49.1%.
read: Como host Sassuolo three days after a 4-1 Champions League win over Manchester United, still clear favourites at 61.5% but rated only about a goal better than Sassuolo after the handicap line came in from -1.28 to -1.07. The market expects goals, with a 3.25 total and Over at 49.1%, matching two teams whose recent games have been full of them.

facts.fact: Como beat Manchester United 4-1 in the Champions League on Tuesday night.
facts.meaning: They come into this on a high, but it was their third competitive match in eight days.

facts.fact: Como are 61.5% to win this match, more than three times Sassuolo's 17.3%.
facts.meaning: The market makes Como clear favourites at home, with the draw at 21.2%.

facts.fact: Como have three days between the Manchester United match and this one; Sassuolo have had eight since their last game.
Como's win chance has slipped from 66.4% to 61.5% in recent days, while Sassuolo's has risen from 13.2% to 17.3%.
facts.meaning: Prices have shortened on Sassuolo and drifted on the hosts, so the gap is narrower than it was at the weekend.

facts.fact: Como sit fifth in Serie A with 14 points from seven games, four wins, two draws and one defeat.
facts.meaning: That league record is the backbone of their favouritism, even with the squad stretched.

facts.fact: Italian media reported a defensive alarm at Sassuolo after a 2-4 defeat at Frosinone, describing players as available but their readiness uncertain.
facts.meaning: They arrive off a heavy defeat, with the back line the part of the team under most scrutiny.

facts.fact: Como's attacker A. Diao, who has four goals and an assist in 536 minutes this season, is out with a thigh injury, and defender T. Chalobah is also missing.
facts.meaning: Como lose their most productive attacking option behind the strikers and a regular at the back, right in their busiest week.

facts.fact: Sassuolo's most-used defender F. Leysen, 492 minutes in seven games, is out with a knee injury, with J. Idzes also missing.
facts.meaning: Sassuolo's defence, already the weaker unit, is short at the back for the trip to Como.

sources.fact: Como beat Manchester United 4-1 in the Champions League, a result described as a historic triumph for the Serie A side.
Como pulled off a statement win over Juventus on Serie A matchday three.
Cesc Fabregas said Rodriguez faces a long spell out, while Assane will return after the international break.
Fabregas called the Manchester United tie a historic day and said he does not accept the word crisis being applied to United.
Como president Mirwan Suwarso said hosting Manchester United in the Champions League is unreal for a club that was in the third division until 2021.
Como's Champions League fixture with Manchester United was in doubt because of severe weather in northern Italy.
Italian media report that Sassuolo have dropped five positions in the table during October.
Italian media report a defensive alarm at Sassuolo after a step backwards at Frosinone, with players available but their readiness uncertain ahead of the trip to Como.
